pmcoe-ai1-pmp-tutor-skill-root.description: PMP / CAPM / PMI-ACP / PMI-CP study companion built by PMCOE LLC — a PMI Authorized Training Partner. Use when the user asks about the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification exam, the Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), PMI-Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or PMI Construction Professional (PMI-CP). Covers the 2021 Exam Content Outline, eligibility requirements, scenario-based question practice, the 50/50 predictive-vs-agile mix, GI Bill funding (Chapter 31 / Chapter 33), WEAMS verification for veterans (facility code 46P05243), and PMI Authorized Training…
